verdict.rationale: Alloy's own docs say it runs AML checks across KYC/KYB, which covers both individuals and businesses. Its webhook docs also refer to asynchronous events "when a watchlist gets updated", which implies watchlist screening exists. Neither is more than a glancing mention. Missing for 10: documented sanctions/watchlist screening functionality, ability to select specific sanctions lists or watchlists, explicit company/entity screening details, match handling or review docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can screen individuals and companies against selected sanctions and watchlists

citations.quote: asynchronous events like when a watchlist gets updated
Streamline perpetual KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks with fully auditable agentic automation
